camera.iphone_candid: candid smartphone photo, slightly imperfect framing, natural phone-camera grain, auto exposure, mild wide-lens distortion, unposed moment
camera.gf_pov: casual smartphone photo taken by his girlfriend across the table or a few steps away, intimate, slightly off-centre, unposed
camera.street: street photography from a distance with a 50mm lens, subject unaware of the camera, passers-by partially in frame, natural motion
camera.editorial: luxury fashion editorial photograph, 85mm lens, shallow depth of field, controlled soft light, muted colour grade
camera.cinematic_night: cinematic night photograph, 35mm lens, practical city lights, deep shadows, subtle film grain, anamorphic-like highlights
camera.handheld_video: handheld smartphone video frame, natural micro-shake, slight motion blur
camera.mirror: mirror selfie with phone partly covering the lower face, natural indoor light
camera.pov: first-person POV shot from his perspective, his hands visible, immersive
camera.still_life: intimate still-life detail photograph, natural window light, shallow depth of field, tactile textures
camera.drone_wide: wide cinematic landscape shot, tiny human figure for scale, natural atmosphere

time_of_day.dusk: blue-hour dusk light with first city lights
time_of_day.late_night: 2 a.m. stillness, sparse lights, cold ambient glow
time_of_day.rain_night: rainy night, wet reflective surfaces, light rain visible in light sources

face.direct: he looks directly into the lens with a calm, controlled stare
face.away: he looks away from the camera, unaware or uninterested
face.partial: his face is partly hidden (turned, cropped, in shadow, or behind a cup/book)
face.back: seen from behind, face not visible
face.none: he is not in frame or only his hands appear
